judgments.reason: The passage states that the model was evaluated on the self-driving car by replacing the existing planner with M4 and that the driving behaviors observed in simulation were replicated. This matches the claim exactly.

The passage says videos are available and that they illustrate the smoothness of the network’s driving ability, its ability to deal with stop-signs and turns, and to drive for long durations in full closed-loop control without deviating from the trajectory. This matches the claim.

The passage defines open-loop evaluation as taking test examples of expert driving data and computing the L2 distance error between predicted and ground-truth waypoints for each example. This matches the claim.
The passage states that Fig. 8a shows the L2 distance metric in the open-loop evaluation setting for models M0 and M4 on a test set of 10,000 examples. This matches the claim.
